name: LazySQL AI smoke QA
description: Human-like smoke coverage of the real LazySQL TUI against the existing manual database fixtures.

cases.title: Records pagination uses the MySQL orders fixture
oracles: The seeded orders Records surface opens and shows a non-empty first page.
PageNext loads a different later page without an error.
PagePrev returns to the original first-page row.

cases.title: Foreign Key Jump follows a seeded PostgreSQL relationship
oracles: The customer_id foreign-key cell is visibly navigable after metadata arrives.
Enter opens public.customers filtered to the selected customer_id value.
The target row proves the relationship rather than merely opening an unrelated table.

cases.title: SQL editor streams and caps order_items results
oracles: The SQL editor renders a non-empty intermediate result while the SELECT is active.
The final result is from order_items and visibly reports 1,000 rows shown.
The final status reports result truncation with maximum 1,000.
